title: research: PIV sign() ERR_SW vs ERR_ENCODING on empty response
description: wp11_piv_sign() returns WP11_PIV_ERR_SW when the 7C/82 tag is absent in the response (condition: i >= data_end || resp[i] != TAG_DAT). When the card returns SW 9000 but zero payload bytes, the correct error is ERR_ENCODING (malformed response), not ERR_SW (wrong SW bytes). Research: verify which error code callers in wp11_pkcs11.c handle, and whether changing to ERR_ENCODING would break any caller error-dispatch logic. If not, fix for semantic accuracy.
